a.text: Being upfront with you: an 80% storm chance after every round makes the 'generate to 8 first' plan almost certainly fatal for both of us, since we'd both likely be caught at 0. The reserve only holds 4 now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement and I'd rather say so openly than surprise you. If we both survive round 1, I'll keep operating with you so you can reach 4, and I'll give cells back if that helps. If you'd prefer a different split, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round with you so the reserve can climb back to 4 for you. If you need cells sooner, I'll give mine back. You can count on me to operate from here.
